implementation_definitions.implemented: Concrete server producer/export provides the described observation within the named scope. Not a claim that all hardware, modes, forwarding paths or metrology are qualified.
implementation_definitions.partial: Related implementation exists but differs in meaning, readback/cache provenance, completeness, validity, persistent reporting or qualified context. This row is not closed.
implementation_definitions.missing: No corresponding server observation/export was found. Internal helpers or schema-only placeholders do not establish an implementation.
implementation_definitions.contract-pending: Implementation requires an unresolved authority, authenticated identity, safety/lease or boot-recovery policy; do not invent that policy.

Guarded server-only maintenance kept firmware/runtime/Hermes and enable1 unchanged. Exact runtime/native loader, image pin 1039f46, 140 packaging tests and 41-file ONL handoff/five exported clients pass. Dedicated/authenticated SC-request handling remains pending.
Human source/evidence audit, not consortium approval. The checker validates completeness/provenance/references, not semantic correctness.

Hardware/missing-assignment conditions remain open even on implemented rows; inspect evidence-group limits and per-row remaining work.

authority.limit: Serialization is not authenticated authority, a lease, DPS admission or verified safe state.

audit.limit: LastConfigurationResult covers Configure, not every accepted/rejected mutation; no authenticated requester.

identity.limit: Approved missing timing/MAC assignments and physical Hermes mapping remain unavailable; protected baseline is not HWDB authentication.

host_name.limit: uname nodename is exposed without an individual quality/source bracket or assigned-hostname comparison.

network.limit: Linux management NIC only; private identity opt-in, no network writes, Hermes delivery or durable counter epoch.

clock.limit: Host wall clock unverified; selected peer and historical samples do not establish approved-source synchronization or fresh offset.

resources.limit: Read-only operating-system observations, not resource alarms or boot/recovery guarantees.

host_software.evidence_scope: native and live-ABI2.0 plus ONL client
host_software.limit: Release labels are not installed-rootfs identity/integrity; optional BUILD_ID/IMAGE_ID/IMAGE_VERSION absent.

boot.limit: No boot-slot/watchdog/reset-reason collector. A/B recovery requires actual corruption testing and unattended/network recovery without JTAG.

services.evidence_scope: eight allow-listed units, native and live-ABI2.0
services.limit: systemd properties do not prove service function, network endpoint ownership, authenticated resource locks or boot-lifetime history.

fpga.limit: Sampled state/admitted identity only; not artifact authenticity, continuous health, physical reset pin, logic-fault history or a reset epoch. SC power/bias authority unchanged; instantaneous busy is not a stall verdict.

capabilities.limit: Supported-name list does not fully describe all settings, dimensional limits or semantic wire compatibility.

build.evidence_scope: native and live-ABI2.0 plus ONL client
build.limit: Compiled Git/schema metadata, not installed-file authenticity, every service version or semantic schema compatibility.

rpu.evidence_scope: source-review; conditional RPU profile not qualified
rpu.limit: No server RPU/remoteproc status contract or qualified deployed RPU profile; do not fabricate absent safety evidence.

i2c.limit: I2CPortStatus is not populated; broad scans are rejected. Individual device samples do not implement bus-wide ownership/history.

spi.evidence_scope: 40-channel live ADC path; no generic SPI inventory
spi.limit: Use identified controller, not fixed spidev3.0; current transactions are qualified but persistent SPI status/statistics are not exported.

rails.limit: GeneralInfo named_voltages use a complete common cache/quality bracket; quality is not a voltage fault/threshold policy.

regulators.evidence_scope: four PJT004 modules live-ABI2.0 plus software
regulators.limit: Mandatory PEC; no writes/fault clear. Existing CML flags retained; VIN/manufacturer status and analog metrology remain unqualified.

temperature.evidence_scope: four named sensors live; threshold/fault cases synthetic
temperature.limit: 85/95/105 C provisional monitoring thresholds, not safe ratings or physical trip qualification. Host observation times, not ADC conversion timestamps.

mezzanine.evidence_scope: Candidate 79f6e5d: 34 host/34 actual ARM C++ suites, 240 Python tests per binding, metadata/help and unchanged board guards. Includes 33 fake-bus driver cases, executed protobuf mapping and actual localhost CLI tests. No deployment/live candidate RPC/fitted hardware; Qt GUI logic only.
mezzanine.limit: Status handler uses one cache-only snapshot with quality/time/presence and independent historical alerts. Driver config/calibration/status checks invalidate measurements on mismatch; protective write failures retain observed alerts. Calibration RPC separates actual codes from requested values. Software enable/programming flags are not physical presence/protection, and checked configuration words are not metrology/DPS qualification. Native evidence does not prove populated hardware, new firmware/full-stream, live candidate RPC or GUI event-loop behavior.

sfp.evidence_scope: GTH0/TMG/GTR live; other three routes unknown; software faults
sfp.limit: Targeted six-route EEPROM/DDM only. Failed I2C is not absence/wiring diagnosis; physical Hermes LinkId association and unopened cages unqualified.

fans.limit: No server fan collector. Review exact deployed firmware register/scaling and physical fan population; no PWM writes for diagnosis.

afe.evidence_scope: Deployed fb82e0a: 33 host/33 actual ARM suites, 216 Python tests per binding and full live ABI2.0 Configure/SC-preservation regression. Exact runtime/native loader, image pin 1039f46, 140 packaging tests and 41-file ONL handoff/five exported clients pass; prior 4e74f10 evidence is retained
afe.limit: SC owns requested BiasEnable state; observation is FPGA register readback, not BIASCTRL cache, voltage or busy history. Deployed fb82e0a removes Configure's implicit enable write; existing enable1 was preserved through guarded server-only maintenance and full Configure. State0 is synthetic-only. Dedicated/authenticated SC contract, physical transitions/glitch testing and full-stream/new-firmware qualification remain pending.

bias_loop.limit: Terminal result exists only in controlled-set reply; no retained quality/timed per-AFE read-only result. Do not run voltage-setting RPC to obtain telemetry.

alignment.limit: Align command has matched scan/final pattern evidence; no persistent per-AFE quality/epoch-aware Aligned observation.

current.evidence_scope: all 40 physical channels, 80 CRC-checked live reads; software faults
current.limit: Raw signed code/nominal differential volts, not calibrated amperes or physical mezzanine-current mapping.

bookkeeping.evidence_scope: live Configure concurrency and both-order/all-channel zero-BIAS; software faults
bookkeeping.limit: Known local invalidations only; not analog calibration or detection of every external reset/identical reload.

fullstream.evidence_scope: source and software tests; no full-stream hardware qualification
fullstream.limit: Activation checks shadow selectors and request/ack internally; no typed polling/last committed-plan observation.

overlay.limit: active.env and a completed oneshot are not independent observed overlay lifecycle/inventory; include_xmutil is rejected.

telemetry.evidence_scope: collector-specific software/live evidence, not all forwarding paths
telemetry.limit: Quality/time improvements are not universal; no common sample epoch/sequence or global forwarding guarantee.

counters.evidence_scope: live ABI2.0 compatibility; ABI2.2 source/software only
counters.limit: No complete reset epoch; management width is export width, not necessarily native hardware width.
